speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To help me narrow down the cause, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes, or any changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).

Thank you for the details. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, fatigue, and severe itching, I suspect an autoimmune condition. Please confirm: are your stool and urine colors normal? REQUEST TEST: Serum antimitochondrial antibody (AMA), Total Bile Acids, and Liver Ultrasound.
